html:
The peak of Da Chong Mountain has a unique shape, with stone slabs stacked on top of each other, especially the rocky outcrop jutting out over the edge of the cliff, which is a check-in spot that many tourists visit when they have the opportunity to come to Ha Long.

Currently, the peak of Da Chong Mountain is an attractive destination, especially for tourists who love to explore new things and conquer the majestic heights that nature has bestowed upon this place.

Located at an altitude of hundreds of meters above sea level, but the peak of Da Chong Mountain has its own beauty, and is a destination chosen by many tourists when traveling to Ha Long. Coming here, visitors will encounter a unique beauty because the stone slabs are stacked quite high, which is a virtual living spot chosen by many tourists.

The precariously stacked stone slabs create a unique feature, from above, visitors can see the entire beauty of Ha Long city from above, surrounded by mountain ranges or immense pine forests.

In addition, Da Chong mountain is also associated with fairy tales or places such as Khe Mung, Khe Lieu, Phuong Hoang mountain… is one of the sacred mountains of the Dao Thanh Y people, Bang Ca commune.

If you have the opportunity to go on a tour Ha Long, visitors should visit Da Chong mountain to visit, enjoy and listen to thrilling stories from the elders here.

To fully admire the beauty of Da Chong mountain, visitors should go to Bang Ca commune, then take a boat across the lake, go to Khe Mung and swim in the cool water. This is a destination for young people who love adventure travel and want to conquer heights, crossing the Su Tu rock mountains to the top of Chong mountain, visitors will be satisfied with the beauty of Ha Long from above.

After the rains, there will be beautiful clouds, as if wanting to embrace the scenery of the immense pine forest surrounding Yen Lap lake like a fairyland, a unique beauty that attracts backpackers.

Especially when conquering Da Chong mountain peak, visitors can also take beautiful pictures, in the middle of the fairyland, no matter what angle they stand from, visitors can still take beautiful pictures.

It is worth noting that to reach Da Chong mountain peak, visitors should prepare good health, when going down the boat, choose a boat that is qualified to move on the lake and wear a life jacket, and bring food and drinks because the route you conquer is a route without shops.
